items.title: MemoryGate – Open-source persistent memory for AI agents via MCP
items.raw_excerpt:
I built MemoryGate because I kept watching context vanish.
I run multiple AI agents across Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Every time a model updated, a platform changed its API, or a context window rolled over — everything the agent had learned was gone. Preferences, decisions, project history, relationship context. Just... wiped.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 国务院国资委日前提出，中央企业要强化投资牵引，积极扩大算力有效投资，推进“算力+电力”协同发展，提升全链条数据治理能力，不断夯实人工智能产业基础底座。记者11日获悉，国务院国资委日前召开中央企业“AI+”专项行动深化部署会。此次会议上，国务院国资委提出央企要强化自主创新，着力突破关键核心技术，持续攻关“大模型”技术，推动更多自主创新成果从样品变成产品、形成产业；要强化场景培育，加强人工智能与主责主业、产业需求的精准对接，在高适配、高价值、高可靠上下更大功夫，推动人工智能规模化落地应用。此外，国务院国资委要求中央企业强化开源开放协同，加快推动开源“焕新社区”迭代升级，努力成为“赋能型企业”，推进“AI+”产业共同体建设，不断涵养互利共赢的产业生态。（新华社）
excerpt_i18n.en: The State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC) of the State Council recently proposed that central enterprises should strengthen investment traction, actively expand effective investment in computing power, promote the coordinated development of "computing power + electricity," enhance the entire chain's data governance capabilities, and continuously consolidate the foundation of the artificial intelligence industry. On the 11th, it was learned that SASAC recently convened a deepening deployment meeting for the "AI+" special action of central enterprises. At this meeting, SASAC called on central enterprises to reinforce independent innovation, focus on breaking through key core technologies, continuously tackle "large model" technology, and push more innovative achievements from prototypes to products and industries. They are also required to strengthen scenario cultivation, accurately align artificial intelligence with primary responsibilities, industrial needs, and make greater efforts in high compatibility, high value, and high reliability to promote large-scale application of AI. Additionally, SASAC requires central enterprises to strengthen open-source collaboration, accelerate the iteration and upgrade of the open-source "Renewal Community," strive to become "empowering enterprises," advance the construction of the "AI+" industrial community, and continuously foster a mutually beneficial and win-win industrial ecosystem. (Xinhua News Agency)
excerpt_i18n.es: El Consejo de Administración del Consejo de Estado propuso recientemente que las empresas estatales centrales fortalezcan la inversión en tracción, expandan activamente la inversión efectiva en capacidad de cálculo, promuevan el desarrollo coordinado de "capacidad de cálculo + electricidad", mejoren la capacidad de gobernanza de datos en toda la cadena y consoliden constantemente la base de la industria de inteligencia artificial. El 11 se informó que el Consejo de Administración del Consejo de Estado había celebrado recientemente una reunión para profundizar la implementación de la iniciativa especial "AI+" de las empresas estatales centrales. En esta reunión, el Consejo de Administración del Consejo de Estado propuso que las empresas estatales centrales fortalezcan la innovación autónoma, se esfuercen por superar tecnologías clave y nucleares, continúen atacando la tecnología de "grandes modelos" y promuevan que más resultados de innovación autónoma pasen de muestras a productos y se conviertan en industrias; deben fortalecer la formación de escenarios, mejorar la conexión precisa entre la inteligencia artificial y las responsabilidades principales y las necesidades de la industria, con alta adaptabilidad y alto valor.

items.raw_excerpt: 米兰·科尔蒂纳冬奥会2月6日正式开幕。在意大利米兰斯福尔扎古堡前广场，国际奥委会主席柯丝蒂·考文垂参观了充满未来感的“米兰·阿里廊”（Alibaba Wonder on Ice），沉浸式体验了AI数字购物。     （图：国际奥委会主席考文垂在“米兰·阿里廊”沉浸式体验AI数字购物）     淘宝Vision打造了一个未来购物空间，为冬奥会带来 “AI+3D+XR”相融合的先锋体验。游客戴上头显后，就能在AI助手帮助下，创建基于千问大模型生成的专属数字人形象，选择服饰、妆容、喷上香水，参加一场奇妙的冰雪舞会。   这场全观感奇幻之旅，基于阿里巴巴的云和AI技术底座。淘宝Vision自研的3D高斯真人数字人技术，通过实时渲染与空间交互，实现从挑选货物到虚拟试用的AI数字购物链路，让更多人以数字化、个性化的方式参与冬奥会，拥有属于自己的奥运时刻。   "米兰·阿里廊"是阿里巴巴在米兰斯福尔扎古堡前广场设置的体验馆，于米兰冬奥会和残奥会期间对游客开放。展馆由一颗直径8.8米的透明水晶球和一座总长约30米的冰晶穹顶组成。水晶球白天作为互动空间，夜间变身为AI生成视觉内容的投影表面。   “Ciao～我是来自Alibaba的AI小助手！欢迎你来到Wonder on Ice的梦幻舞会。”游客进入"米兰·阿里廊"后，AI助手就会打招呼，引导签到、拍照、生成专属入场券，随后就进入了虚拟试衣体验区。   在这里，AI助手会识别体验者的穿衣风格，通过简单问答和手势交互，推荐舞会穿搭。“你看看这两款怎么样？左边这款采用仿生学设计，环保材质，可以凸显你的身材，右边这款具有防水保温的功效。”     （图：游客可以生成专属数字人，体验虚拟换装） &nb

The Milan Cortina Winter Olympics officially opened on February 6. At the Piazza in front of Sforza Castle in Milan, IOC President Kirsty Coventry visited the futuristic "Alibaba Wonder on Ice" and experienced immersive AI digital shopping.

Taobao Vision created a future shopping space, bringing a cutting-edge experience of "AI + 3D + XR" to the Winter Olympics. After putting on headsets, visitors can create their own personalized digital avatars with the help of an AI assistant, based on models generated by Qwen. They can choose clothing, makeup, and even spray perfume before attending a magical ice ball.

This full-sensory fantasy journey is powered by Alibaba's cloud and AI technology. Taobao Vision's proprietary 3D Gaussian real-person digital human technology, through real-time rendering and spatial interaction, realizes an AI digital shopping chain from selecting items to virtual try-ons, allowing more people to participate in the Olympics digitally and personally, creating their own Olympic moments.

"Alibaba Wonder on Ice" is an experience pavilion set up by Alibaba at the Piazza in front of Sforza Castle in Milan, open to visitors during the Milan Winter Olympics and Paralympics. The pavilion features a transparent crystal sphere with a diameter of 8.8 meters and a total length of about 30 meters.

items.title: 豆包官宣总台春晚互动玩法 将送机器人等十万份科技大礼
items.raw_excerpt: 2月10日，豆包宣布“豆包过年”新春活动正式开启，活动期间将为用户发放新春红包。此外，除夕夜的中央广播电视总台2026年春晚期间，豆包还将为全国观众送出超过10万份接入豆包大模型的科技好礼，以及现金红包。  据介绍，今年的豆包新春活动分为两个阶段。第一阶段将于2月13日20点正式启动，用户可进入豆包App新春活动页面，体验AI生成拜年祝福等AI过年玩法，即可参与抽奖赢取红包，中奖后可提现。  2月16日除夕夜，豆包将在中央广播电视总台春晚期间，配合直播互动，开启第二阶段红包及科技礼包抽奖。当晚，用户将有三轮机会赢取最高8888元的现金红包或接入豆包大模型的智能科技好礼。  据了解，此次豆包送出的“科技礼包”囊括17款热门产品，包括宇树机器人、拓竹3D打印机、大疆无人机等前沿科技产品，也有极米投影仪、苏泊尔电饭煲等智能消费品，同时，科技好礼中还涵盖上汽奥迪E5 Sportback和奔驰CLA两款电车使用权。  值得一提的是，此次抽取的科技奖品均通过火山引擎深度融合了豆包大模型能力。以总台春晚即将送出的宇树机器人为例，其拟人的音色与语气由豆包大模型的语音合成模型、大语言模型（LLM）以及视觉语言模型（VLM）技术提供支持。奖品中的上汽奥迪E5  Sportback基于豆包大模型打造“奥迪助手”，让用户和汽车可以实现近乎真人的自然对话体验。  “豆包过年”项目负责人表示，希望借助科技礼包，让更多人感受到大模型发展为生活带来的便利，也希望借此激发更多人关注并参与科技创新，让科技成果更多走进生活。  从目前公布的红包规则来看，今年豆包新春活动有两个亮点：一是简单直接，互动玩法门槛低，用户可直接领取红包；二是形式新颖，除基础红包外，科技礼包品类丰富，覆盖了从前沿科技到日常家居的多元场景，将线上互动进一步延展

On February 10, Doudou announced the official launch of its "Doudou New Year" Spring Festival event, which will distribute New Year red envelopes to users during the activity period. Additionally, during the CCTV 2026 Spring Festival Gala on New Year's Eve, Doudou will offer over 100,000 tech gifts integrated with the Doudou large model and cash red envelopes to viewers nationwide.

This year's Doudou New Year event is divided into two phases. The first phase starts at 8 PM on February 13, where users can enter the Doudou App's Spring Festival event page to experience AI-generated New Year greetings and other AI-themed activities, participating in lucky draws for red envelopes that can be cashed out upon winning.

On New Year's Eve, February 16, Doudou will collaborate with the live broadcast of the CCTV Spring Festival Gala to kick off the second phase of red envelope and tech gift lucky draws. That night, users will have three chances to win cash red envelopes of up to 8,888 yuan or smart tech gifts connected to the Doudou large model.

It is understood that the "tech gift packages" offered by Doudou this time include 17 popular products, ranging from cutting-edge tech items like Unitree robots, Topology 3D printers, and DJI drones, to smart consumer goods such as JIMI projectors and Supor rice cookers. The tech gifts also include the use rights for the SAIC Audi E5 Sportback and Mercedes-Benz CLA electric vehicles.

Notably, all the tech prizes drawn this time are deeply integrated with the Doudou large model capabilities. For example, the Unitree robot to be given away during the CCTV Spring Festival Gala features human-like voice and tone generated by the Doudou large model.
